items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: He taught Barney, Simeon, Fazola, oh yeah.

ctx.x: Wonderful clarinet player. But I hear he was one of the greatest of all.

Yes sir. He taught Barney, Simeon, Fazola, oh yeah. But how about you? What about me? Did he teach you? No. No. In 1937, first time I'd seen him in New York, he said, how long have you been playing clarinet? Oh yeah? I said, oh I don't know. He said, well you played the hell out of it, Father, I'm concerned. That's what he told me. It made me feel wonderful. Did he die in New York?
